# Noor-e-Quran Institute

> Noor-e-Quran Institute is an accredited global online Islamic educational institution delivering structured 1-on-1 private Quran recitation, Tajweed, Noorani Qaida, Hifz-ul-Quran (memorization), and Islamic Studies classes for kids, adults, and slow learners across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Pakistan.

## Institute Overview
- **Institution**: Noor-e-Quran Institute
- **Website**: [Noor-e-Quran Institute Home](https://noorequraninstitute.me)
- **WhatsApp Support**: [Direct WhatsApp Chat](https://wa.me/923274496163)
- **Email**: [Contact Admissions](mailto:info@noorequraninstitute.me)
- **Free Trial**: [Book 3-Day Free Trial](https://noorequraninstitute.me/free-trial)
- **Tutor Roster**: 30+ Certified Male and Female Alim/Qari/Hafiz instructors
- **Class Format**: 1-on-1 Live Interactive Sessions via Zoom/Google Meet
- **Languages of Instruction**: English, Urdu, Arabic

## Core Learning Programs
- [Noorani Qaida for Beginners](https://noorequraninstitute.me/noorani-qaida): Arabic alphabet phonetics, articulation points (Makharij), and Harakaat.
- [Nazra Quran with Tajweed](https://noorequraninstitute.me/quran-reading-nazra): Fluent reading of the 30 Juz with proper rules of Noon Sakinah, Meem Sakinah, and Madd.
- [Quran Recitation & Tajweed Rules](https://noorequraninstitute.me/quran-with-tajweed): Intensive phonetic mastery, Waqf stop signs, and classical vocal cadence.
- [Hifz-ul-Quran Memorization](https://noorequraninstitute.me/quran-memorization-hifz): Structured Sabaq (new lesson), Sabqi (recent revision), and Manzil (cumulative retention).
- [Islamic Studies & Duas](https://noorequraninstitute.me/islamic-studies): Daily supplications, 6 Kalimahs, Salah prayers, and moral manners.
- [Female Quran Tutors](https://noorequraninstitute.me/female-quran-teacher): Dedicated certified female scholars for sisters, daughters, and young girls.
